scope: Thirteen high-authority public documents normalized to a seven-field versioning tuple and included in a deterministic website-content candidate.

tests.detail: Thirteen documents matched all seven metadata fields; duplicate-path, invalid-commit, metadata-mismatch and missing-change-log mutations were rejected.
53 named artifacts, 17 JSON records, 13 search pages, 43 public documents, nine release states and all three authority gates passed.
30 JSON records, 12 authoritative fact classes and nine release states passed.
Package builder and verifier negative self-tests passed.
No disallowed deployment filler was found; bounded recursive grep fallback was used because ripgrep was unavailable.
Credential-pattern scan passed using the bounded recursive grep fallback.
Go vet, Shell syntax and JavaScript syntax checks passed.
README positioning and objective-state records passed.
All Go packages passed or contained no test files.
The exact committed-source archive passed source-commit, byte-count, SHA-256, manifest completeness and required-input verification.

limitations: The locally and CI-verified 2d38cac artifact is not the currently Website-accepted or publicly hosted archive.
Website acceptance, public hosting and production signing require separate direct evidence.
Public StreamBFT activation, Treasury audit, stablecoin reserve/redemption, solvency attestation and effective legal notices are not claimed.
Named legal, economic, consensus, security, privacy and asset-rights reviews remain external.
